professional.notes: No verified pro review retrieved (bot-walls; see SHARED-lg-gram.md).

praises: 17-inch screen at ~1.5 kg is unmatched — buyers cite it as the only big-screen laptop that feels like a 14"
Numeric keypad on the Max chassis is a real spreadsheet win
Copilot+ NPU and Wi-Fi 7 on the 2025 Arrow Lake board
Good port set for the thickness: HDMI, USB-A, microSD, dual TB4
Solid battery for a 17-inch machine on light workloads
complaints: Only 16GB soldered RAM at this price limits longevity and multitasking headroom
60 Hz glossy panel feels basic next to same-price matte 120 Hz rivals
Lid flex and hinge wobble on the large 17" lid are more noticeable than on smaller grams
Speakers are thin and bass-light, typical of the thin gram chassis
LG Vantage bloat and spotty firmware update cadence in Canada

design_philosophy: The gram Max pushes the line's lightness gimmick to its largest canvas: a 17-inch Copilot+ laptop with a numeric keypad that still weighs less than most 15-inch ultrabooks. Magnesium-nano-carbon keeps it ~1.5 kg; the cost is a basic 60 Hz glossy panel and 16GB soldered RAM at entry tiers. It targets road-warriors and finance/spreadsheet users who want maximum screen per gram rather than maximum performance.
